title: SIPP care and work constraints differ by work-limiting disability status
source_unit: SIPP person record by reference month, stratified by released work-limiting-condition recode, using final person and Fay-BRR replicate weights

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own disability and conditional universe

observations.method: Official disability status flag and child-care status flags/universes; WPFINWGT full estimate and 240 Fay-BRR replicate weights with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; the time-lost cell is very small and highly imprecise.
observations.subgroup: EDISABL code 1: work-limiting condition, age-15-plus official universe.
observations.counterinterpretation: Disability status is a released survey recode, not a complete health, care-need, or work-capacity measure; the result does not identify accommodation, provider access, or causation.

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own disability and conditional universe

observations.method: Same official-universe and Fay-BRR method as the work-limiting-condition subgroup.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; time lost remains conditional on work prevention.
observations.subgroup: EDISABL code 2: no work-limiting condition, age-15-plus official universe.
observations.counterinterpretation: This is a reference group, not a counterfactual for disability; differences can reflect age, family composition, work, resources, or care arrangements.

related_sources.claim: Official disability recode, status flags, child-care universes, and labels.

boundary: This is a person-weighted, design-based disability-status comparison. It does not establish health or care need, accommodation, household prevalence, causal effects, time substitution, recovery, trust, or political action.
